title: Fit test: one Pulse Laser III ship with a Shield Booster II against a pilot whale (220 hull) at Stellar Siphon, alone
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-22 16:11 UTC (orders ENT-064, block APOPHIS; rule F9: prey above the one-ship gauges is a test, one side at a time; F37: three results). Does one PL3 ship with a Shield Booster II kill a pilot whale alone over 60 percent hull? A side of three PL3 ships did, three of three at full hull (observations kind group_hunt, 2026-11-22). The whale hits back: a railgun starter fell from 73 to 15 of 75 hull in one fight (hunt-home-whale, 2026-11-15); the hunter flees under 60 percent. Herd: 4 pilot whales at 16:05 UTC (data/wildlife/nexus_prime.json), claimed by Military (admirals.log ENT-093). The loot goes to a trader receiver (gift_to, P5). 2026-11-22 20:21 UTC (Apophis): proven (F37): 8 kills in 9 runs, lowest hull 97 percent; it stays standing work for one Shield Booster II ship; four more whale herds near home take one ship each (hunt-*-pilot-whale-sb2).
